name: ui-layouts-3d-marquee
blurb: 3D-rotated marquee carousel with perspective transform and fade edges.
description: A marquee carousel with CSS 3D transform applied (rotated perspective). Shows vertically scrolling items with side fade gradients and hover effects.
use_when: A logo wall or rotating item showcase that needs a 3D presentation effect.
avoid_when: On older browsers or when you need to customize items and transforms at runtime.
a11y: Images have alt text. Carousel is continuous without keyboard control.
